arguments.text: Let the pack go. Settle into your own steady rhythm.

text: let_go: on the wash at 196 W shaft vs 160 W sustainable, pod reserve empties in under 800 m.

arguments.text: Let them go now. Ease to your own steady pace.

arguments.message: pod effort more than 10 pct above sustainable shaft power

text: no cue: let_go cue blocked by 60 s spacing; added a watch to re-check pod effort above sustainable.

arguments.text: Ease a touch. Long smooth strokes, hold this rhythm.

text: ease: pod effort 164 W above 159 W sustainable, pod reserve 52 pct would empty in 2.7 km.
no cue: pod effort 162 W within 2 pct of sustainable after the ease cue; removed boat-model over_pace watch firing on an empty boat reserve with no fade.

arguments.reason: boat reserve read empty for 7 min at 105-113 W boat power with no fade; steady 10-min boat power 112.6 W

text: no cue: pod effort 160 W at sustainable 159 W, no fade; raised boat critical power to 108 W since boat reserve read empty with speed holding.
no cue: pod effort 160 W at sustainable level, speed holding, reserve 40 pct for 8 km.

arguments.text: Ease slightly. Settle at 3:04 pace, smooth and long.

text: ease to 184 s/500: pod effort 166 W above sustainable 159 W, pod reserve 28 pct empties in 1.2 km of 7.2 km left.

arguments.text: Ease a little on this leg, save it for the return.

arguments.message: pod effort creeping above sustainable with reserve under 30 pct

text: ease: pod reserve fell to 20 pct with 7 km left after a surge to 169 W; ease on the favourable leg, push on the adverse one.
no cue: pod effort 154 W just under sustainable 159 W on the favourable leg, reserve rebuilt to 34 pct, speed holding.
no cue: new leg, pod effort 154 W slightly under sustainable 159 W with 34 pct reserve; paddler tends to lift effort into the current.

arguments.text: Lift a little into this current. Aim for 3:01 pace.

text: push to 181 s/500: pod effort 153 W below sustainable 160 W with 41 pct reserve, and effort pays most into the adverse current.
no cue: pod effort 161 W at sustainable 160 W, reserve 39 pct for 5 km, speed holding.

arguments.text: After the turn, into the current: lift it, hold 2:59.

text: push to 179 s/500 on the coming adverse leg: pod effort 149 W well below sustainable 162 W with 54 pct reserve and 4 km left.
no cue: new leg just began, push cue only seconds ago; allow it to take effect.
no cue: pod effort 160 W at sustainable 161 W, reserve 38 pct for 3.2 km; 2 pct fade is not yet sustained.

arguments.text: Lengthen out: drop the rate two, keep the pressure on.

text: rate_down: speed at this rate fading 2.7 pct and worsening over 2 min at steady 66 spm while pod reserve holds; best rate drops with fatigue.

arguments.text: Turn into the current: lift it, hold 3:00 pace.

text: push to 180 s/500 on the coming adverse leg: pod effort 152 W well below sustainable 166 W with 49 pct reserve and 2 km left.
no cue: push cue for this leg given seconds ago; let it take effect.

arguments.text: Start building now. Lift to 3:00 pace, sprint comes soon.

text: push to 180 s/500: 1.2 km left with 49 pct pod reserve unspent and effort 158 W well below sustainable 172 W, into the current.

arguments.text: Last leg. Lift it now, hold 2:28 pace, then sprint.

arguments.message: 450 m to go: time to call the finishing sprint

text: push to 148 s/500 on the favourable last leg: half the pod reserve unspent with 1 km left; watch set to call the sprint at 450 m.

arguments.text: Go now! Sprint home, empty it by the line.

text: finish: 757 m left with 48 pct pod reserve unspent and speed holding; spend it to the line.

arguments.text: Ease a touch, hold this speed, kick again near the line.

text: ease: sprint at 206 W would empty the pod reserve in 220 m with 535 m left; about 180 W lasts to the line.
no cue: sprint already under way and an ease cue was given seconds ago; another cue is not allowed yet.
no cue: ease cue under 60 s ago, a new cue is not allowed yet; 388 m left in the sprint.
